scope: All 175 lib/**/*.ex source files parsed without compilation or macro evaluation. Function heads, default arities, callbacks, structs, use/behaviour declarations and quoted templates are indexed. This is a declared-source inventory, not a complete expanded BEAM export list or passing behavior evidence.
limits: Doc annotations belong to individual source declarations; unspecified clauses do not override an earlier hidden doc.
Quoted templates identify their source owner, not an expanded consumer module. Conditional declarations are retained.
Use/derive/DSL macros can add exports not listed as literal function heads. Their public contracts need consumer compilation during the port.
A documented implementation callback is not automatically a permanent public API. Replaced runtime contracts require the mapped behavior and migration guide.
